resources.description: UK company lookup (Companies House). One UK company by number or name, live from the official Companies House API: profile, status, type, SIC codes, registered-office area, accounts and confirmation-statement dates and overdue flags, charges, the latest filing events and corporate persons with significant control. Blind Mode: officers and individual PSCs are never ingested — filing events carry the category code, not the name. Cached 24 h. One call returns one record as JSON.

Verify a UK business on the official Companies House register by company NAME or NUMBER: legal name, status (active, dissolved, liquidation), type, incorporation date, registered address, SIC codes, accounts overdue, charges, insolvency history and current directors. Use for KYB, supplier or customer checks, due diligence, or confirming a UK business is real and active. Name searches also return other close matches. Errors: 404 not found.
